_comment: genai lane splits (tools/genai_data.py, docs/research/genai.md). Counts and hashes only: the items hold numbers of the data root and live outside the repository.

rule.scouting: players of players.json in sha256('genai-v1:' + slug) order: the first 20 percent test, the next 10 percent dev, the rest train
rule.possession: development games (tools.research_testset.dev_games) with a possessions table, in sha256('genai-v1:' + game id) order: 40 test, 20 dev, 120 train, the rest unused; per game {'test': 12, 'dev': 12, 'train': 25} possessions drawn with random.Random(sha256 key)

training_build_notes: Shot time: a site build takes the release frame when it finds the shooter's tracked position at that frame, else the play-by-play event frame. This builder reads no tracking frame, so it takes the release frame whenever the attempt has a shooter and a release frame inside the possession, else the event frame.

Shooter fallback: a site build names a shooter with no tracked id from the shot chart's player slug when exactly one rostered player has it. This builder does not read the shot chart, so such a shot has no shooter.
attack_x is set to 0.0 and the frame arrays are empty: possession_input reads neither (it works on the public copy, which empties the frame arrays).
